steps.message:
You are an AI assistant tasked with solving command-line tasks in a Linux environment. You will be given a task description and the output from previously executed commands. Your goal is to solve the task by providing batches of shell commands.

Format your response as JSON with the following structure:

{
  "analysis": "Analyze the current state based on the terminal output provided. What do you see? What has been accomplished? What still needs to be done?",
  "plan": "Describe your plan for the next steps. What commands will you run and why? Be specific about what you expect each command to accomplish.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "ls -la\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "cd project\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }
  ],
  "task_complete": true
}

Required fields:
- "analysis": Your analysis of the current situation
- "plan": Your plan for the next steps
- "commands": Array of command objects to execute

Optional fields:
- "task_complete": Boolean indicating if the task is complete (defaults to false if not present)

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete before the next command will be executed (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used completely verbatim as keystrokes. Write commands exactly as you want them sent to the terminal:
- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:
  - C-c for Ctrl+C
  - C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

Task Description:
You are the computational biologist of a functional-genomics core facility. 3 pooled CRISPR drug-modifier screens that a colleague who has left had started to analyse have to be released: screens A, B, C.
They are independent experiments with their own samples, files and hand-over notes; they follow the same
facility rules.

Task directory:
- `/task`

For every screen X of A, B, C:
- inputs (read-only): `/task/input/part_X/`
- the complete brief of that screen: `/task/input/part_X/BRIEF.md` (inputs, task, required outputs and
  constraints; it is written for that screen alone)
- deliverables: `/task/output/part_X/`

Available software (on `PATH`): `cutadapt`, `mageck` (MAGeCK), Python 3.12 with numpy, scipy and
pandas. There is no internet access.

The project is released as a whole: it is accepted only if every screen is accepted on its own.

Constraints:
- Do not modify anything under `/task/input`; write deliverables only under `/task/output/part_X/`.
- Do not ask for confirmation. Execute directly.

# SOP FG-017: pooled CRISPR drug-modifier screens, analysis and release (rev. 4)

## 1. Scope
Secondary (validation) knockout screens with a T0 reference, a vehicle arm and a drug arm. This
SOP states what a released analysis has to satisfy. It does not prescribe software.

## 2. Library annotation
Only the current release of a library annotation is used. For VAL-2 this is release 2
(`library.tsv`). Release 2 corrected the gene assignment of 80 sgRNAs (20 genes) that
were mislabelled in release 1 (a sub-pool of the oligo order sheet was shifted against its gene
column); sgRNA ids and sequences did not change. Release 1 is withdrawn.

## 3. Counting and sample identity
- A read is counted for an sgRNA if it carries that sgRNA's spacer in the amplicon context
  described in the wet-lab notes. Every library of the sample sheet is counted and reported.
- The sample sheet is what the wet lab wrote down. Before any contrast is computed, the arm of
  every day-14 library is confirmed from the data: the sgRNA profile of a library has to agree
  better with the other libraries of its arm than with the libraries of the other arm. A library
  that does not is analysed in the arm its profile supports. The arm in which each library was
  analysed is recorded in `qc.json`.

## 4. Scales
Log2 fold changes are reported on the scale on which the non-targeting sgRNAs do not change
(median non-targeting sgRNA = 0). The fitness effect is vehicle day 14 against T0. The drug effect
is drug day 14 against vehicle day 14; negative values mean depletion under drug.

## 5. Release criterion for modifier calls
The library carries reference genes for the compound class (`reference_genes.tsv`): modifiers with
their expected class and genes established not to modify the response (`none`); the reference
`none` genes cover the whole range of fitness effects. A call set is released only if
- at least 9 of the 10 reference modifiers are called with their expected class, and
- at most 1 of the 30 reference `none` genes is called (either class).
The reference genes are reported like every other gene.

## 6. Hand-over audit checklist
When a project changes hands, the new analyst checks the inherited files and records one verdict
per item in `audit.tsv`: `ok` if the statement holds, `defective` if it does not. Each item is
judged on its own: an effect that follows from the defect of another item is recorded under the
item that caused it, not under every item it touches.

| item | statement |
|---|---|
| `library_release` | The sgRNA-to-gene annotation in the inherited count table is that of the current library release. |
| `sample_columns` | No sample column of the inherited count table was counted from a FASTQ file other than the one the sample sheet lists for that sample. (A c
olumn without any counts is the subject of `read2_library`, not of this item.) |
| `stagger_reads` | The inherited count table contains the reads of all stagger variants of the amplicon, not only of one read layout. |
| `read2_library` | The library that was delivered as Read 2 has been counted: no sample column of the inherited count table is empty. |
| `arm_labels` | The inherited analysis script takes the arm of each library from the sample sheet; every library is thereby analysed in the arm of the treatmen
t it actually received. |
| `control_normalisation` | The inherited analysis script reports log2 fold changes on the scale of section 4 (non-targeting sgRNAs at 0). |
| `drug_baseline` | The drug effect in the inherited analysis script compares the drug arm with the vehicle arm of day 14, not with T0. |
| `contrast_sign` | In the inherited analysis script a negative drug effect means depletion under drug. |

The inherited gene table and hit list are the output of the inherited analysis script run on the
inherited count table with the sample sheet.

## 7. Erratum
If results have left the facility, an erratum lists every gene of the mailed list with one verdict:
`confirmed` if the gene is a modifier (either class) in the released analysis, `retracted` if not.

- `fastq/<sample_id>.fastq.gz` - one single-end FASTQ per library (8 libraries)
- `samples.tsv` - sample sheet as it was submitted with the libraries (`sample_id`, `arm`,
  `replicate`, `fastq_file`, `sequencing_run`); `arm` is `T0`, `vehicle` or `drug`
- `library.tsv` - current release (r2) of the sgRNA library: `sgRNA`, `sequence`, `gene`.
  Non-targeting control sgRNAs have `gene = NON_TARGETING`. Gene identities were blinded by the client.
- `reference_genes.tsv` - library genes whose behaviour under this compound is established
  (`gene`, `expected_class`)
- `screen_design.md` - wet-lab notes on the library, the treatment arms, PCR and sequencing
- `screen_sop.md` - the facility SOP for drug-modifier screens: definitions, acceptance criteria,
  the hand-over audit checklist
- `handover/` - the colleague's project folder: `HANDOVER.md`, `count_guides.py`,
  `analyse_screen.py`, `counts_draft.tsv`, `gene_draft.tsv`, `hits_mailed.tsv`

Available software (on `PATH`): `cutadapt`, `mageck` (MAGeCK), Python 3.12 with numpy, scipy and
pandas. There is no internet access.

Your task:
1. Count how many reads carry each library sgRNA in every library.
2. For every targeted gene, estimate the fitness effect of the knockout and its effect on the
   response to the drug, and classify the gene as sensitiser, resistance gene or neither.
3. Audit the inherited project against the checklist in section 6 of the SOP.
4. Write the erratum for the hit list that was mailed.

Required outputs under `/task/output/part_B`:
- `counts.tsv` - tab-separated, header `sgRNA`, `gene`, then one column per `sample_id` in the
  order of `samples.tsv`. One row per sgRNA of `library.tsv` (non-targeting sgRNAs included), `gene`
  as in `library.tsv`. Values are raw integer read counts of the FASTQ file listed for that sample.
- `gene_summary.tsv` - tab-separated with at least the columns `gene`, `lfc_fitness`, `lfc_drug`,
  `drug_class`; one row per targeted gene (no row for `NON_TARGETING`). Extra columns are allowed.
  - `lfc_fitness`: log2 fold change of the gene, vehicle-treated libraries of day 14 versus T0,
    defined as the median over the gene's sgRNAs of the sgRNA-level log2 ratio of depth-normalised
    abundance (mean of the replicates of one group over mean of the replicates of the other). The
    scale must be such that a knockout without any fitness effect has `lfc_fitness` = 0.
  - `lfc_drug`: the same quantity for drug-treated versus vehicle-treated libraries of day 14;
    negative means less abundant under drug. A knockout that does not change the drug response
    has `lfc_drug` = 0.
  - `drug_class`: `sensitiser` if the gene's sgRNAs are significantly less abundant under drug than
    under vehicle, `resistance` if they are significantly more abundant, otherwise `none`; false
    discovery rate 5%. The calls must satisfy the release criterion of SOP section 5.
  - Libraries are grouped by the treatment they actually received (SOP section 3).
- `audit.tsv` - tab-separated, columns `item`, `verdict`; one row per checklist item of SOP
  section 6, `verdict` is `ok` or `defective`.
- `erratum.tsv` - tab-separated, columns `gene`, `verdict`; one row per gene of
  `handover/hits_mailed.tsv`. `verdict` is `confirmed` if your final `drug_class` of the gene is
  `sensitiser` or `resistance`, and `retracted` if it is `none`.
- `qc.json` - `{"samples": {"<sample_id>": {"total_reads": <int>, "mapped_reads": <int>, "arm": "<T0|vehicle|drug>"}, ...}}`
  where `total_reads` is the number of reads in the FASTQ, `mapped_reads` the number of reads
  assigned to a library sgRNA and `arm` the group in which you analysed the library.

Constraints:
- Do not modify anything under `/task/input/part_B`; write deliverables only under `/task/output/part_B`.
- Every library in the sample sheet belongs to the experiment and must be reported and used.
- Do not ask for confirmation. Execute directly.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""count_guides.py - sgRNA read counts for the VAL-2 screens (K.B.)

usage: count_guides.py LIBRARY.tsv SAMPLES.tsv OUT.tsv FASTQ [FASTQ ...]

One FASTQ per row of the sample sheet, given in the same order as the rows.
Only exact matches to a library spacer are counted.
"""
import gzip
import sys

COMP = str.maketrans("ACGTN", "TGCAN")
SCAFFOLD = "GTTTTAGAGCTA"


def revcomp(s):
    return s.translate(COMP)[::-1]

def candidates(read):
    # the spacer is the 20 nt in front of the scaffold
    k = read.find(SCAFFOLD)
    if k >= 20:
        yield read[k - 20:k]


def main():
    lib_path, sheet_path, out_path = sys.argv[1:4]
    fastqs = sys.argv[4:]
    guides, by_seq = [], {}
    with open(lib_path) as fh:
        head = fh.readline().rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        i_id, i_seq, i_gene = head.index("sgRNA"), head.index("sequence"), head.index("gene")
        for line in fh:
            f = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
            by_seq[f[i_seq]] = len(guides)
            guides.append((f[i_id], f[i_gene]))
    with open(sheet_path) as fh:
        fh.readline()
        samples = [line.split("\t")[0] for line in fh if line.strip()]
    if len(fastqs) != len(samples):
        sys.exit("need one FASTQ per sample sheet row")
    counts = [[0] * len(samples) for _ in guides]
    for j, path in enumerate(fastqs):
        with gzip.open(path, "rt") as fh:
            for n, line in enumerate(fh):
                if n % 4 != 1:
                    continue
                for spacer in candidates(line.rstrip()):
                    k = by_seq.get(spacer)
                    if k is not None:
                        counts[k][j] += 1
                        break
    with open(out_path, "w") as out:
        out.write("sgRNA\tgene\t" + "\t".join(samples) + "\n")
        for (sg, gene), row in zip(guides, counts):
            out.write(sg + "\t" + gene + "\t" + "\t".join(map(str, row)) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
===== B analysis script
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""analyse_screen.py - gene table and hit list for the VAL-2 drug screen (K.B.)

usage: analyse_screen.py COUNTS.tsv SAMPLES.tsv OUT_GENES.tsv OUT_HITS.tsv
"""
import sys

import numpy as np

TOP = 40                             # genes that go into the hit list
counts_path, sheet_path, out_genes, out_hits = sys.argv[1:5]

rows = [line.rstrip("\n").split("\t") for line in open(counts_path) if line.strip()]
cols, rows = rows[0][2:], rows[1:]
gene = np.array([r[1] for r in rows])
C = np.array([[float(v) for v in r[2:]] for r in rows])
arm = {}
for line in list(open(sheet_path))[1:]:
    f = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    if len(f) > 1:
        arm[f[0]] = f[1]

keep = [j for j in range(len(cols)) if C[:, j].sum() > 0]        # a library without reads is left out
t0 = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "T0"]
veh = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "vehicle"]
drug = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "drug"]
ntc = gene == "NON_TARGETING"

# size factors from the non-targeting sgRNAs
size = np.ones(len(cols))
tot = C[ntc].sum(axis=0)
size[keep] = tot[keep] / tot[keep].mean()
N = C / size


def lfc(a, b):
    return np.log2((N[:, a].mean(axis=1) + 0.5) / (N[:, b].mean(axis=1) + 0.5))


fit = lfc(veh, t0)
drg = lfc(t0, drug)
fit = fit - np.median(fit[ntc])
drg = drg - np.median(drg[ntc])

# gene level: median over the sgRNAs; z against the spread of the non-targeting sgRNAs
null_sd = np.std(drg[ntc]) / 2.0          # a gene is the median of four sgRNAs
table = []
for g in sorted(set(gene[~ntc])):
    m = gene == g
    lf, ld = float(np.median(fit[m])), float(np.median(drg[m]))
    z = ld / null_sd
    cls = "none" if abs(z) < 3 else ("sensitiser" if z < 0 else "resistance")
    table.append((g, lf, ld, z, cls))

with open(out_genes, "w") as out:
    out.write("gene\tlfc_fitness\tlfc_drug\tz_drug\tdrug_class\n")
    for g, lf, ld, z, cls in table:
        out.write("%s\t%.4f\t%.4f\t%.2f\t%s\n" % (g, lf, ld, z, cls))

with open(out_hits, "w") as out:
    out.write("rank\tgene\tz_drug\n")
    for i, (g, lf, ld, z, cls) in enumerate(sorted(table, key=lambda r: -abs(r[3]))[:TOP]):
        out.write("%d\t%s\t%.2f\n" % (i + 1, g, z))

usage: analyse_screen.py COUNTS.tsv SAMPLES.tsv OUT_GENES.tsv OUT_HITS.tsv
"""
import sys

import numpy as np

TOP = 80                             # genes that go into the hit list
counts_path, sheet_path, out_genes, out_hits = sys.argv[1:5]

rows = [line.rstrip("\n").split("\t") for line in open(counts_path) if line.strip()]
cols, rows = rows[0][2:], rows[1:]
gene = np.array([r[1] for r in rows])
C = np.array([[float(v) for v in r[2:]] for r in rows])
arm = {}
for line in list(open(sheet_path))[1:]:
    f = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    if len(f) > 1:
        arm[f[0]] = f[1]

keep = [j for j in range(len(cols)) if C[:, j].sum() > 0]        # a library without reads is left out
t0 = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "T0"]
veh = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "vehicle"]
drug = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "drug"]
ntc = gene == "NON_TARGETING"

# size factors from the non-targeting sgRNAs
size = np.ones(len(cols))
tot = C[ntc].sum(axis=0)
size[keep] = tot[keep] / tot[keep].mean()
N = C / size


def lfc(a, b):
    return np.log2((N[:, a].mean(axis=1) + 0.5) / (N[:, b].mean(axis=1) + 0.5))


fit = lfc(veh, t0)
drg = lfc(veh, drug)
fit = fit - np.median(fit[ntc])
drg = drg - np.median(drg[ntc])

# gene level: median over the sgRNAs; z against the spread of the non-targeting sgRNAs
null_sd = np.std(drg[ntc]) / 2.0          # a gene is the median of four sgRNAs
table = []
for g in sorted(set(gene[~ntc])):
    m = gene == g
    lf, ld = float(np.median(fit[m])), float(np.median(drg[m]))
    z = ld / null_sd
    cls = "none" if abs(z) < 3 else ("sensitiser" if z < 0 else "resistance")
    table.append((g, lf, ld, z, cls))

with open(out_genes, "w") as out:
    out.write("gene\tlfc_fitness\tlfc_drug\tz_drug\tdrug_class\n")
    for g, lf, ld, z, cls in table:
        out.write("%s\t%.4f\t%.4f\t%.2f\t%s\n" % (g, lf, ld, z, cls))

with open(out_hits, "w") as out:
    out.write("rank\tgene\tz_drug\n")
    for i, (g, lf, ld, z, cls) in enumerate(sorted(table, key=lambda r: -abs(r[3]))[:TOP]):
        out.write("%d\t%s\t%.2f\n" % (i + 1, g, z))

steps.message:
Analysis: Read layouts show run A FASTQs are forward amplicons, while the re-sequenced run B files are Read 2 (reverse-complement orientation). We need robust counting for both orientations and all stagger lengths before analysis.
Plan: Create a reusable Python counting script under /tmp that parses each library, counts exact spacer matches in forward or reverse-complement amplicon context, writes draft counts to /tmp, and prints per-sample total/mapped read counts. Then inspect resulting count matrices and correlations.

arguments.keystrokes:
cat > /tmp/count_screens.py <<'PY'
import gzip, os, sys, json
from collections import OrderedDict

COMP = str.maketrans('ACGTN', 'TGCAN')
FWD = 'GTTTTAGAGCT'
REV = 'AGCTCTAAAAC'

def revcomp(s):
    return s.translate(COMP)[::-1]

def load_library(path):
    lib=[]
    with open(path) as fh:
        head=fh.readline().rstrip('\n').split('\t')
        ii=head.index('sgRNA'); iseq=head.index('sequence'); ig=head.index('gene')
        for line in fh:
            if not line.strip(): continue
            f=line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
            lib.append((f[ii], f[ig], f[iseq]))
    return lib

def candidates(read):
    out=[]
    k=read.find(FWD)
    if k>=20:
        out.append(read[k-20:k])
    k=read.find(REV)
    if k>=0 and k+len(REV)+20 <= len(read):
        out.append(revcomp(read[k+len(REV):k+len(REV)+20]))
    # dedupe preserving order
    seen=set(); ded=[]
    for s in out:
        if s not in seen:
            seen.add(s); ded.append(s)
    return ded

def main(part):
    base=f'/task/input/part_{part}'
    lib=load_library(f'{base}/library.tsv')
    seq_to_idx={seq:i for i,(sg,gene,seq) in enumerate(lib)}
    samples=[]
    with open(f'{base}/samples.tsv') as fh:
        head=fh.readline().rstrip('\n').split('\t')
        for line in fh:
            if not line.strip(): continue
            f=line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
            samples.append(dict(zip(head,f)))
    counts=[[0]*len(samples) for _ in lib]
    qc={}
    for j,s in enumerate(samples):
        path=os.path.join(base,'fastq',s['fastq_file'])
        total=mapped=0
        with gzip.open(path,'rt') as fh:
            for n,line in enumerate(fh):
                if n%4!=1: continue
                total += 1
                read=line.strip()
                hit=None
                for cand in candidates(read):
                    if cand in seq_to_idx:
                        hit=seq_to_idx[cand]; break
                if hit is not None:
                    counts[hit][j]+=1; mapped+=1
        qc[s['sample_id']]={'total_reads':total,'mapped_reads':mapped,'arm':s['arm'],'fastq_file':s['fastq_file']}
    out=f'/tmp/counts_{part}.tsv'
    with open(out,'w') as oh:
        oh.write('sgRNA\tgene\t'+'\t'.join(s['sample_id'] for s in samples)+'\n')
        for (sg,gene,seq),row in zip(lib,counts):
            oh.write(sg+'\t'+gene+'\t'+'\t'.join(map(str,row))+'\n')
    with open(f'/tmp/qc_{part}.json','w') as oh:
        json.dump({'samples':qc},oh,indent=2)
    print(f'===== {part} qc =====')
    for sid,d in qc.items():
        print(sid, d['arm'], d['total_reads'], d['mapped_reads'], d['fastq_file'])

if __name__=='__main__':
    for p in sys.argv[1:]:
        main(p)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr
for part in 'ABC':
    print('='*20, part)
    df=pd.read_csv(f'/tmp/counts_{part}.tsv',sep='\t')
    sample_file=f'/task/input/part_{part}/samples.tsv'
    s=pd.read_csv(sample_file,sep='\t')
    cols=list(s.sample_id)
    C=df[cols].values.astype(float)
    # log CPM with pseudocount, normalized by total mapped counts
    lib=df.gene.values
    libsize=C.sum(0)
    X=np.log2(C/libsize*1e6+1)
    # correlation matrix Pearson
    R=np.corrcoef(X.T)
    print(s[['sample_id','arm']].to_string(index=False))
    print('Pearson corr:')
    print(pd.DataFrame(R,index=cols,columns=cols).round(3).to_string())
    # group means excluding self
    for sid in cols:
        a=s.loc[s.sample_id==sid,'arm'].iloc[0]
        others=s[(s.sample_id!=sid)]
        same=others[others.arm==a].sample_id.tolist()
        diff=others[others.arm!=a].sample_id.tolist()
        j=cols.index(sid)
        if same and diff:
            ms=np.mean([R[j,cols.index(x)] for x in same])
            md=np.mean([R[j,cols.index(x)] for x in diff])
            print(f'{sid} sheet {a}: same {ms:.4f}, diff {md:.4f}, delta {ms-md:.4f}')

    # hierarchical clustering on day14 profiles, all genes, log counts

    idx=[cols.index(x) for x in d14]
    Xd=np.log2(C[:,idx]+1).T
    # correlation distance

    D=1-R2

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""count_guides.py - sgRNA read counts for the VAL-2 screens (K.B.)

usage: count_guides.py LIBRARY.tsv SAMPLES.tsv OUT.tsv FASTQ [FASTQ ...]

One FASTQ per row of the sample sheet, given in the same order as the rows.
Only exact matches to a library spacer are counted.
"""
import gzip
import sys

COMP = str.maketrans("ACGTN", "TGCAN")
SCAFFOLD = "GTTTTAGAGCTA"


def revcomp(s):
    return s.translate(COMP)[::-1]

def candidates(read):
    yield read[24:44]             # Read 1: the spacer follows the 24 nt of the U6 primer site
    yield revcomp(read)[15:35]    # run B delivered Read 2: same spacer seen from the other end


def main():
    lib_path, sheet_path, out_path = sys.argv[1:4]
    fastqs = sys.argv[4:]
    guides, by_seq = [], {}
    with open(lib_path) as fh:
        head = fh.readline().rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        i_id, i_seq, i_gene = head.index("sgRNA"), head.index("sequence"), head.index("gene")
        for line in fh:
            f = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
            by_seq[f[i_seq]] = len(guides)
            guides.append((f[i_id], f[i_gene]))
    with open(sheet_path) as fh:
        fh.readline()
        samples = [line.split("\t")[0] for line in fh if line.strip()]
    if len(fastqs) != len(samples):
        sys.exit("need one FASTQ per sample sheet row")
    counts = [[0] * len(samples) for _ in guides]
    for j, path in enumerate(fastqs):
        with gzip.open(path, "rt") as fh:
            for n, line in enumerate(fh):
                if n % 4 != 1:
                    continue
                for spacer in candidates(line.rstrip()):
                    k = by_seq.get(spacer)
                    if k is not None:
                        counts[k][j] += 1
                        break
    with open(out_path, "w") as out:
        out.write("sgRNA\tgene\t" + "\t".join(samples) + "\n")
        for (sg, gene), row in zip(guides, counts):
            out.write(sg + "\t" + gene + "\t" + "\t".join(map(str, row)) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats

actual={
'A':{'T0':['LIB8','LIB9'],'vehicle':['LIB11','LIB12','LIB15'],'drug':['LIB10','LIB13','LIB14']},
'B':{'T0':['LIB6','LIB7'],'vehicle':['LIB8','LIB9','LIB13'],'drug':['LIB10','LIB11','LIB12']},
'C':{'T0':['LIB8','LIB9'],'vehicle':['LIB10','LIB12','LIB13'],'drug':['LIB11','LIB14','LIB15']},
}

def bh(p):
    p=np.asarray(p,float); n=len(p); order=np.argsort(p); ranked=p[order]; q=ranked*n/np.arange(1,n+1); q=np.minimum.accumulate(q[::-1])[::-1]; out=np.empty(n); out[order]=np.minimum(q,1); return out

for part in 'ABC':
    print('='*35,part)
    df=pd.read_csv(f'/tmp/counts12_{part}.tsv',sep='\t')
    s=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{part}/samples.tsv',sep='\t')
    ref=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{part}/reference_genes.tsv',sep='\t')
    cols=list(s.sample_id); C=df[cols].values.astype(float); gene=df.gene.values
    sizes=C.sum(0); N=C/sizes*1e6
    veh=[cols.index(x) for x in actual[part]['vehicle']]; drug=[cols.index(x) for x in actual[part]['drug']]
    lfc=np.log2((N[:,drug].mean(1)+0.5)/(N[:,veh].mean(1)+0.5))
    lfc-=np.median(lfc[gene=='NON_TARGETING'])
    genes=np.array(sorted(set(gene)-{'NON_TARGETING'}))
    med=np.array([np.median(lfc[gene==g]) for g in genes])
    means=np.array([np.mean(lfc[gene==g]) for g in genes])
    sds=np.array([np.std(lfc[gene==g],ddof=1) for g in genes])
    n=4
    t=means/(sds/np.sqrt(n))
    p_t=2*stats.t.sf(np.abs(t),df=n-1)
    q_t=bh(p_t)
    # empirical gene-median null from observed NTC guides: all combos of 4 from 80
    ntc=lfc[gene=='NON_TARGETING']
    from itertools import combinations
    # too many combos 1.58M okay but sample instead
    rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
    null_med=np.median(rng.choice(ntc,size=(200000,4)),axis=1)
    p_emp=np.array([(np.sum(np.abs(null_med)>=abs(x))+1)/(len(null_med)+1) for x in med])
    q_emp=bh(p_emp)
    # inherited z using NTC std/2
    null_sd=np.std(ntc)/2
    z=med/null_sd
    p_z=2*stats.norm.sf(np.abs(z)); q_z=bh(p_z)
    print('guide lfc NTC median after center',np.median(ntc))
    for name, calls in [('ttest', q_t<0.05),('emp_median',q_emp<0.05),('z_norm',q_z<0.05)]:
        mod_ok=none_bad=0; details=[]
        for _,r in ref.iterrows():
            i=np.where(genes==r.gene)[0][0]; called=calls[i]
            if r.expected_class!='none':
                expected = 'sensitiser' if med[i]<0 else 'resistance'
                ok=called and expected==r.expected_class
                mod_ok+=ok; details.append((r.gene,r.expected_class,round(med[i],3),bool(called),ok))
            else:
                none_bad+=called
        print(f'{name}: modifiers_ok={mod_ok}/10 none_called={none_bad}/30 total_calls={calls.sum()}')
        # print mismatched modifiers and false none calls
        print('  modifier mismatches:',[(d[0],d[1],d[4]) for d in details if not d[4]])
        false_none=[genes[i] for i in np.where(calls)[0] if ref.set_index('gene').expected_class.get(genes[i],'x')=='none']
        print('  none called:',false_none[:10], '...' if len(false_none)>10 else '')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats

actual={
'A':{'T0':['LIB8','LIB9'],'vehicle':['LIB11','LIB12','LIB15'],'drug':['LIB10','LIB13','LIB14']},
'B':{'T0':['LIB6','LIB7'],'vehicle':['LIB8','LIB9','LIB13'],'drug':['LIB10','LIB11','LIB12']},
'C':{'T0':['LIB8','LIB9'],'vehicle':['LIB10','LIB12','LIB13'],'drug':['LIB11','LIB14','LIB15']},
}

def bh(p):
    p=np.asarray(p,float); n=len(p); order=np.argsort(p); ranked=p[order]; q=ranked*n/np.arange(1,n+1); q=np.minimum.accumulate(q[::-1])[::-1]; out=np.empty(n); out[order]=np.minimum(q,1); return out

for part in 'ABC':
    print('='*40,part)
    df=pd.read_csv(f'/tmp/counts12_{part}.tsv',sep='\t')
    ref=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{part}/reference_genes.tsv',sep='\t')
    cols=list(pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{part}/samples.tsv',sep='\t').sample_id)
    C=df[cols].values.astype(float); gene=df.gene.values
    genes=np.array(sorted(set(gene)-{'NON_TARGETING'}))
    sizes=C.sum(0)
    CPM=C/sizes*1e6
    # gene summed CPM
    G=np.array([CPM[gene==g].sum(1) for g in genes])  # genes x samples
    veh=[cols.index(x) for x in actual[part]['vehicle']]; drug=[cols.index(x) for x in actual[part]['drug']]
    # center each gene by NTC median logFC? not necessary for t-test, but report effect
    lfc_gene=np.log2((G[:,drug].mean(1)+0.5)/(G[:,veh].mean(1)+0.5))
    ntc_lfc=np.log2((G[genes=='NON_TARGETING'][0,drug].mean()+0.5)/(G[genes=='NON_TARGETING'][0,veh].mean()+0.5)) if 'NON_TARGETING' in genes else 0
    # Actually NTC omitted from genes; compute separately
    ntc_sum=CPM[gene=='NON_TARGETING'].sum(0)
    ntc_lfc=np.log2((ntc_sum[drug].mean()+0.5)/(ntc_sum[veh].mean()+0.5))
    lfc_gene_centered=lfc_gene-ntc_lfc
    # t-test on log2 CPM summed gene counts, pseudo 1
    LG=np.log2(G+1)
    t=[]; p=[]
    for i in range(len(genes)):
        tt=stats.ttest_ind(LG[i,drug],LG[i,veh],equal_var=False)
        t.append(tt.statistic); p.append(tt.pvalue)
    q=bh(p)
    # same but per-replicate log ratio drug-vehicle after depth/NTC normalization
    # use guide-level median lfc for required output
    lfc_guides=np.log2((CPM[:,drug].mean(1)+0.5)/(CPM[:,veh].mean(1)+0.5))
    ntc_med_guide=np.median(lfc_guides[gene=='NON_TARGETING'])
    lfc_guides-=ntc_med_guide
    med=np.array([np.median(lfc_guides[gene==g]) for g in genes])
    print('Gene-sum test:')
    calls=q<0.05
    mod_ok=none_bad=0; mism=[]
    for _,r in ref.iterrows():
        i=np.where(genes==r.gene)[0][0]
        if r.expected_class!='none':
            expected='sensitiser' if lfc_gene_centered[i]<0 else 'resistance'
            ok=bool(calls[i] and expected==r.expected_class)
            mod_ok+=ok
            if not ok: mism.append((r.gene,r.expected_class,round(lfc_gene_centered[i],3),bool(calls[i])))
        else:
            none_bad+=calls[i]
    print('  calls',calls.sum(),'mod_ok',mod_ok,'none_bad',none_bad)
    print('  mism',mism)
    # Print top by p
    top=np.argsort(p)[:20]
    print('  top p:')
    for i in top[:12]:
        print('   ',genes[i],'p',round(p[i],2),'q',round(q[i],3),'lfc_gene',round(lfc_gene_centered[i],3),'med_guide',round(med[i],3))

python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
for p in 'ABC':
    print('='*40,p)
    m=pd.read_csv(f'/tmp/mageck_{p}.gene_summary.txt',sep='\t')
    ref=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{p}/reference_genes.tsv',sep='\t')
    # choose direction by lfc, significance from appropriate tail
    m['drug_class']='none'
    m.loc[(m['neg|fdr']<0.05)&(m['neg|lfc']<0),'drug_class']='sensitiser'
    m.loc[(m['pos|fdr']<0.05)&(m['pos|lfc']>0),'drug_class']='resistance'
    # handle potential double calls: prioritize more significant tail
    both=m[(m['neg|fdr']<0.05)&(m['pos|fdr']<0.05)]
    print('genes',len(m),'calls',sum(m.drug_class!='none'),'both tails',len(both))
    mm=ref.merge(m[['id','drug_class','neg|lfc','pos|lfc','neg|fdr','pos|fdr']],left_on='gene',right_on='id',how='left')
    mod=mm[mm.expected_class!='none']; non=mm[mm.expected_class=='none']
    print('mods expected correct called',sum((mod.expected_class==mod.drug_class)),'/',len(mod))
    print(mod[['gene','expected_class','drug_class','neg|lfc','neg|fdr','pos|lfc','pos|fdr']].to_string(index=False))
    print('none called',sum(non.drug_class!='none'),'/',len(non))
    print(non[non.drug_class!='none'][['gene','drug_class','neg|lfc','neg|fdr','pos|lfc','pos|fdr']].to_string(index=False))

Plan: Run an exploratory script implementing multiple gene-level significance approaches: guide-level t-test, paired replicate t-test, gene-sum Welch t-test, and sign-based tests. For each, compute BH FDR and report release criterion metrics.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats

actual={
'A':{'T0':['LIB8','LIB9'],'vehicle':['LIB11','LIB12','LIB15'],'drug':['LIB10','LIB13','LIB14']},
'B':{'T0':['LIB6','LIB7'],'vehicle':['LIB8','LIB9','LIB13'],'drug':['LIB10','LIB11','LIB12']},
'C':{'T0':['LIB8','LIB9'],'vehicle':['LIB10','LIB12','LIB13'],'drug':['LIB11','LIB14','LIB15']},
}
def bh(p):
    p=np.asarray(p,float); n=len(p); order=np.argsort(p); ranked=p[order]; q=ranked*n/np.arange(1,n+1); q=np.minimum.accumulate(q[::-1])[::-1]; out=np.empty(n); out[order]=np.minimum(q,1); return out

for part in 'ABC':
    print('='*45,part)
    df=pd.read_csv(f'/tmp/counts12_{part}.tsv',sep='\t')
    s=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{part}/samples.tsv',sep='\t')
    ref=pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{part}/reference_genes.tsv',sep='\t')
    cols=list(s.sample_id); C=df[cols].values.astype(float); gene=df.gene.values
    sizes=C.sum(0); CPM=C/sizes*1e6
    veh=[cols.index(x) for x in actual[part]['vehicle']]; drug=[cols.index(x) for x in actual[part]['drug']]
    genes=np.array(sorted(set(gene)-{'NON_TARGETING'}))
    ntc=gene=='NON_TARGETING'
    ntc_med=np.median(np.log2((CPM[:,drug].mean(1)+0.5)/(CPM[:,veh].mean(1)+0.5))[ntc])
    methods={}
    # Method 1: guide-level log2 mean ratio t-test across 4 guides
    glfc=np.log2((CPM[:,drug].mean(1)+0.5)/(CPM[:,veh].mean(1)+0.5))-ntc_med
    med=np.array([np.median(glfc[gene==g]) for g in genes])
    p=[]
    for g in genes:
        x=glfc[gene==g]
        p.append(stats.ttest_1samp(x,0).pvalue)
    methods['guide_t']=(med,np.array(p))
    # Method 2: gene-level paired replicate log ratio drug/vehicle (3 pairs)
    G=np.array([CPM[gene==g].sum(0) for g in genes])
    # per pair log2 ratio, center NTC median ratio
    pair=[]
    for a,b in zip(drug,veh):
        pair.append(np.log2((G[:,a]+0.5)/(G[:,b]+0.5)))
    pair=np.array(pair).T
    ntc_pair=[]
    for a,b in zip(drug,veh):
        ntc_pair.append(np.log2((CPM[ntc,a].sum()+0.5)/(CPM[ntc,b].sum()+0.5)))
    pair-=np.array(ntc_pair)
    lfc_gene=pair.mean(1)
    p=[]
    for i in range(len(genes)):
        p.append(stats.ttest_1samp(pair[i],0).pvalue)
    methods['paired_rep_t']=(lfc_gene,np.array(p))
    # Method 3: gene-sum two-sample t on log CPM replicates
    LG=np.log2(G+0.5); LG-=np.median(np.log2(CPM[ntc,:].sum(0)+0.5))
    lfc_gene=LG[:,drug].mean(1)-LG[:,veh].mean(1)
    p=[]
    for i in range(len(genes)):
        p.append(stats.ttest_ind(LG[i,drug],LG[i,veh],equal_var=False).pvalue)
    methods['gene_sum_welch']=(lfc_gene,np.array(p))
    # Method 4: guide-level drug vs vehicle t-test all 12 vs 12 normalized counts (independent guides/reps)
    LG2=np.log2(CPM+1); LG2-=np.median(np.log2(CPM[ntc,:]+1))
    lfc_gene=np.array([LG2[gene==g][:,drug].mean()-LG2[gene==g][:,veh].mean() for g in genes])
    p=[]
    for g in genes:
        sub=LG2[gene==g]
        p.append(stats.ttest_ind(sub[:,drug].ravel(),sub[:,veh].ravel(),equal_var=False).pvalue)
    methods['guide_welch_24']=(lfc_gene,np.array(p))
    for name,(lfc,p) in methods.items():
        q=bh(p)
        calls=q<0.05
        mod_ok=0; none_bad=0; mism=[]
        for _,r in ref.iterrows():
            i=np.where(genes==r.gene)[0][0]
            if r.expected_class!='none':
                expected='sensitiser' if lfc[i]<0 else 'resistance'
                ok=bool(calls[i] and expected==r.expected_class); mod_ok+=ok
                if not ok: mism.append((r.gene,r.expected_class,round(lfc[i],3),round(q[i],3),bool(calls[i])))
            else:
                none_bad+=calls[i]
        print(f'{name:16s} total_calls={calls.sum():3d} mod_ok={mod_ok}/10 none_bad={none_bad}/30')
        if mism: print('  mism',mism)

    f = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    if len(f) > 1:
        arm[f[0]] = f[1]

keep = [j for j in range(len(cols)) if C[:, j].sum() > 0]        # a library without reads is left out
t0 = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "T0"]
veh = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "vehicle"]
drug = [j for j in keep if arm[cols[j]] == "drug"]
ntc = gene == "NON_TARGETING"

# size factors: median of ratios to the geometric mean, all sgRNAs
size = np.ones(len(cols))
with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
    logc = np.log(np.where(C[:, keep] > 0, C[:, keep], np.nan))
    size[keep] = np.exp(np.nanmedian(logc - np.nanmean(logc, axis=1, keepdims=True), axis=0))
N = C / size


def lfc(a, b):
    return np.log2((N[:, a].mean(axis=1) + 0.5) / (N[:, b].mean(axis=1) + 0.5))


fit = lfc(veh, t0)
drg = lfc(drug, veh)

# gene level: median over the sgRNAs; z against the spread of the non-targeting sgRNAs
null_sd = np.std(drg[ntc]) / 2.0          # a gene is the median of four sgRNAs
table = []
for g in sorted(set(gene[~ntc])):
    m = gene == g
    lf, ld = float(np.median(fit[m])), float(np.median(drg[m]))
    z = ld / null_sd
    cls = "none" if abs(z) < 3 else ("sensitiser" if z < 0 else "resistance")
    table.append((g, lf, ld, z, cls))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

actual = {
    'A': {'T0': ['LIB8','LIB9'], 'vehicle': ['LIB11','LIB12','LIB15'], 'drug': ['LIB10','LIB13','LIB14']},
    'B': {'T0': ['LIB6','LIB7'], 'vehicle': ['LIB8','LIB9','LIB13'], 'drug': ['LIB10','LIB11','LIB12']},

}

# SOP section 6 audit verdicts, informed by inherited files.
audit = {
    'A': [
        ('library_release','defective'),
        ('sample_columns','ok'),
        ('stagger_reads','ok'),
        ('read2_library','defective'),
        ('arm_labels','defective'),
        ('control_normalisation','ok'),

        ('drug_baseline','defective'),
        ('contrast_sign','defective'),
    ],
    'C': [
        ('library_release','defective'),
        ('sample_columns','defective'),
        ('stagger_reads','defective'),
        ('read2_library','ok'),
        ('arm_labels','defective'),
        ('control_normalisation','ok'),
        ('drug_baseline','ok'),
        ('contrast_sign','defective'),
    ],
}

for p in 'ABC':
    outdir = f'/task/output/part_{p}'
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    counts = pd.read_csv(f'/tmp/counts12_{p}.tsv', sep='\t')
    samples = pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{p}/samples.tsv', sep='\t')
    cols = list(samples.sample_id)
    C = counts[cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    genes = counts['gene'].to_numpy()

    # Write raw corrected counts.
    counts.to_csv(os.path.join(outdir, 'counts.tsv'), sep='\t', index=False)

    # Depth normalization in counts per million, then NTC-centered guide-level log2 ratios.
    depth = C.sum(axis=0)
    cpm = C / depth * 1e6
    idx = {s: cols.index(s) for s in cols}
    ntc = genes == 'NON_TARGETING'
    def guide_lfc(a, b):
        ai = [idx[x] for x in a]
        bi = [idx[x] for x in b]
        return np.log2((cpm[:, ai].mean(axis=1) + 0.5) / (cpm[:, bi].mean(axis=1) + 0.5))

    fit = guide_lfc(actual[p]['vehicle'], actual[p]['T0'])
    drg = guide_lfc(actual[p]['drug'], actual[p]['vehicle'])
    fit = fit - np.median(fit[ntc])
    drg = drg - np.median(drg[ntc])

    # MAGeCK control-normalized FDR calls (validated to satisfy SOP section 5).
    mg = pd.read_csv(f'/tmp/mg_{p}_control.gene_summary.txt', sep='\t')
    calls = {}
    for _, r in mg.iterrows():
        neg_sig = (r['neg|fdr'] < 0.05) and (r['neg|lfc'] < 0)
        pos_sig = (r['pos|fdr'] < 0.05) and (r['pos|lfc'] > 0)
        if neg_sig and not pos_sig:
            calls[r['id']] = 'sensitiser'
        elif pos_sig and not neg_sig:
            calls[r['id']] = 'resistance'
        else:
            calls[r['id']] = 'none'

    rows = []
    for g in sorted(set(genes) - {'NON_TARGETING'}):
        m = genes == g
        rows.append({
            'gene': g,
            'lfc_fitness': float(np.median(fit[m])),
            'lfc_drug': float(np.median(drg[m])),
            'drug_class': calls.get(g, 'none'),
        })
    pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['gene','lfc_fitness','lfc_drug','drug_class']).to_csv(
        os.path.join(outdir, 'gene_summary.tsv'), sep='\t', index=False)

    # Audit table.
    pd.DataFrame(audit[p], columns=['item','verdict']).to_csv(
        os.path.join(outdir, 'audit.tsv'), sep='\t', index=False)

    # Erratum based on final calls.
    hits = pd.read_csv(f'/task/input/part_{p}/handover/hits_mailed.tsv', sep='\t')
    call_map = {r.gene: r.drug_class for r in pd.DataFrame(rows).itertuples(index=False)}
    err = pd.DataFrame({
        'gene': hits['gene'],
        'verdict': ['confirmed' if call_map.get(g, 'none') in ('sensitiser','resistance') else 'retracted' for g in hits['gene']],
    })
    err.to_csv(os.path.join(outdir, 'erratum.tsv'), sep='\t', index=False)

    # QC JSON with actual analyzed arm.
    with open(f'/tmp/qc12_{p}.json') as fh:
        qc = json.load(fh)
    for sid, d in qc['samples'].items():
        arm = 'T0'
        for a, members in actual[p].items():
            if sid in members:
                arm = a
                break
        d['arm'] = arm
        d.pop('fastq_file', None)
    with open(os.path.join(outdir, 'qc.json'), 'w') as fh:
        json.dump(qc, fh, indent=2)

    print(p, 'written', os.listdir(outdir))

    qc_samples=qc['samples']
    assert list(qc_samples)==sample_ids, (p,'qc sample order')
    for sid in sample_ids:
        mapped=int(counts[sid].sum())
        assert qc_samples[sid]['mapped_reads']==mapped, (p,sid,'mapped')
        assert isinstance(qc_samples[sid]['total_reads'],int), (p,sid,'total type')
        assert qc_samples[sid]['arm'] in ('T0','vehicle','drug'), (p,sid,'arm')

    assert len(gs)==lib.gene.nunique()-1, (p,'gene summary rows')
    assert not (gs.gene=='NON_TARGETING').any(), (p,'ntc in gene summary')
    assert set(gs.columns)>={'gene','lfc_fitness','lfc_drug','drug_class'}
    assert set(gs.drug_class)<={'none','sensitiser','resistance'}

    expected_items=['library_release','sample_columns','stagger_reads','read2_library','arm_labels','control_normalisation','drug_baseline','contrast_sign']
    assert audit.item.tolist()==expected_items, (p,'audit items')
    assert set(audit.verdict)<={'ok','defective'}, (p,'audit verdicts')

    assert err.shape[0]==hits.shape[0], (p,'erratum rows')
    assert err.gene.tolist()==hits.gene.tolist(), (p,'erratum gene order')
    assert set(err.verdict)<={'confirmed','retracted'}, (p,'erratum verdicts')

    mm=ref.merge(gs,on='gene',how='left')
    mod=mm[mm.expected_class!='none']
    non=mm[mm.expected_class=='none']
    mod_ok=int((mod.expected_class==mod.drug_class).sum())
    none_bad=int((non.drug_class!='none').sum())
    assert mod_ok>=9, (p,'modifier release',mod_ok)
    assert none_bad<=1, (p,'none release',none_bad)

    print('counts shape', counts.shape, 'all columns sum to qc mapped')
    print('gene_summary', gs.shape, 'calls', gs.drug_class.value_counts().to_dict())
    print('audit', dict(zip(audit.item,audit.verdict)))
    print('erratum', err.shape, err.verdict.value_counts().to_dict())
    print('release criteria: modifiers',mod_ok,'/10; none false calls',none_bad,'/30')
print('ALL VALIDATIONS PASSED')
